text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens in good health both mentally and physically with a high school graduation certificate or equivalent. 2. Applicants for English-taught programs must submit a copy of official IELTS report (6.0 or above), TOFEL report (over 80) or other English proficiency certificates. 3. China Scholastic Competency Assessment Transcript This assessment is organized by the China Scholarship Counicl on behalf of the Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. All applicants must take the assessment in advance and get the score report. The assessment contents includes professional Chinese, mathematics, physics and chemistry. Fundamental subjects All applicants must take mathematics test. According to different majors, applicants must participate in physics and chemistry tests after confirming with Northeast Forestry University. Language used for testing Assessments for mathematics, physics, and chemistry are available in both Chinese and English. Applicants can choose the language of the test paper based on the teaching language.
